text:
The dish is a square-ish plate about 20 cm across, which I'm using as the ruler. On it are roughly 11 to 12 chunks of honeydew melon, each about 2.5-3 cm, so about 10-15 g of fruit per chunk is too low. A 3 cm cube is about 27 cm³, which is roughly 25 g, and the chunks look somewhat smaller than that, so I'll say about 18 g each.

12 chunks × 18 g ≈ 215 g, which I'll round to about 200 g.

Honeydew has about 36 kcal per 100 g, so 200 g comes to roughly 72 kcal. I'm counting a tiny orange speck (probably a bit of carrot or similar) as negligible.

{"kcal": 70, "mass_g": 200}
